recent_calls.summary: The user, Akia, called to report that their air conditioning was not working and the temperature inside their house was 89 degrees, posing a risk of heat stroke. The agent documented the urgent request and informed Akia that the team would contact them on the next business day, which is Saturday. The call ended with Akia confirming no further assistance was needed.

The user Mina from American Home Shield called to provide details for a work order for a member named Rosalynn Kennedy at a specific address. The agent collected the member's name, address, callback number, and clarified the nature of the work order as expedited. The user decided to confirm some details with the member before finalizing the work order description and ended the call.

The user called to reschedule an appointment and indicated it was an emergency related to their cooling system. The agent collected the emergency information and noted the request to pass along to the team for follow-up. The call ended before the agent could complete the conversation or confirm next steps.

The user, Mayola, called to discuss a concern about a noise from her air conditioning unit and whether something was wrong with it. The agent documented the issue and informed her that a representative would follow up on the next business day since it was after-hours. The call ended with no further requests from the user.
The user called back but decided to try again on Tuesday. The agent offered assistance and the user ended the call without requesting further help or leaving a message.

The call was an inbound after-hours inquiry where the agent greeted the user and offered assistance with heating, cooling, or plumbing services. However, the user did not respond, and the call ended shortly after.

The agent confirmed the details and assured Felicia that the information would be passed along for review during regular business hours.

The agent confirmed the details, updated the callback number, and escalated the issue as an emergency for follow-up on the next business day. The call ended with the agent assuring Donovan that the team will contact him soon.

Donovan called to report that after recent air conditioning work, his hot water was turned off and needs urgent restoration. He requested a technician to call him back immediately as it is an emergency. The agent acknowledged the request and marked it as an emergency for next business day service.

Mayola called after hours to inquire whether she needed to pay the air conditioning technician directly or if her American Home Shield coverage would handle the payment. The agent was unable to connect her to a live representative but documented her questions and assured her that a team member would call her back on the next business day. Mayola also asked about the types of work covered and Saturday availability, which were noted for follow-up.
